purpose: Qualify K-1 II native shutter admission together with the K-01 MSC discovery fix. Driver main 0f2f34e0004011136fa75bf43e215acc0c8b9fdb contains both PRs 168 and 169.

changes.summary: Refresh verified Pentax setting widgets after writes and read EV through camera conditions. On the direct K-1 II, shutter, aperture, ISO, WB and EV changed and restored.
For the shared 25fb:0130 identity, leave the single 08/06/50 MSC interface to usbscsi. Preserve the 645D PTP ability. The direct K-01 now enumerates only once and the separate K-1 II remains visible.

Make native pgphoto admission atomic through the stage2_camera_claim gate, with site-aware operation kind so a waiting setting write is admitted ahead of preview work. Preview fetch pacing is NOT changed by this build; it remains open under #147.
Carry the reviewed autojoin boot-loop recovery and its regression tests. The associated editor settings affect the development checkout only.
Include mainline SD archive layout and Astro installer fixes since v114, including VERSION installation and completeness checking of the staged manifest.

validation_focus: Verify the selected ARM camlibs, USB-SCSI module, native admission paths, installed identity and kit. Recheck the K-01 SCSI port inside pgphoto on Polaris. On the K-1 II verify changed shutter and exact restoration on the device. Live preview cadence is unchanged by this build and is recorded as a baseline observation only.
known_limits: The K-01 on the PC refused ISO 800 to 400 on both the original and fixed builds. A fresh session verified ISO 800 after each trial. MSC discovery and reads are qualified only on the PC. No new K-01 vendor commands are enabled.

No physical 645D was available. Native K-1 II shutter admission requires post-install camera evidence. Preview fetch pacing was never implemented, so no pacing behaviour may be claimed or asserted from this build.
